premises.text: Heavy cloud users still have email as a silo that traps attachments
premises.evidence_span: Large amounts of data are moving into email and just sitting there

premises.text: Cloudless moves email files into connected cloud apps, replaces them with links, automates routing, and applies secure access controls
premises.evidence_span: move these files directly into other cloud services and keep them associated with the context of the original email

premises.text: Cross-application policies and admin visibility keep team data consistently handled
premises.evidence_span: sets policies across the cloud applications that they use so that she can make sure that data is being consistently handled

premises.text: Free for individuals; paid when claiming and governing a group
premises.evidence_span: completely free for individual users. You only pay when you claim a group of people

value.evidence_span: create a secure connected enterprise cloud and control the data workflow across many applications

causal_links.evidence_span: That's a huge waste, and it causes everything to slow down
data is moving seamlessly from one application to another
You only pay when you claim a group of people and you govern the data workflow across them

notes: Manual move, auto-route, and secure share folded into one capability premise (v1.3.2 feature-list rule). Anti-template: silo/product/pricing separately revisable.
